environment_audit.diagnosis: Assigned successful rlm calls returned an empty IPython result. The fail-closed yield detector required either a visible RLMSpawnHandle or other success evidence, so it rejected every real assigned spawn and left tools available for forbidden post-spawn detours.
environment_audit.repair: An empty spawn result is now accepted only when a matching child branch appears at or after that exact spawn timestamp. A causally older branch cannot validate a failed duplicate spawn.

retry_policy: The corrected environment may rerun the same four train-gen task keys with the same sampling seed. This is a controlled infrastructure retry, not a new admission bank; only corrected hard-success traces may qualify.
